title: INFLUENCE AND NEGOTIATION
description: Focuses on analysis, skill development and application of management research to real-life organizational influence, persuasion, negotiation and conflict management situations.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 251, 252, 252H, 351, 352 or 352H.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 251, BA 252, BA 252H, BA 351, BA 352 and BA 352H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Sports Business (020)
  • Wood Products Sales (023)
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Management (196)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Professional Sales (817)
  • Organizational Leadership (818)
  • Human Resource Analytics (902)
  • Human Resource Management (A015)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
  • Organizational Leadership (C190)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
